verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking workspace. Having a coding agent detect and install toolchains is an execution-environment capability outside that category. The evidence shows Shortcut connecting to external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI through its MCP server, not running its own agent environment that installs dependencies, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
